headline: GPT-Live-1.1 system card reports voice-safety regressions on synthetic adversarial prompts
summary: OpenAI's October 15 GPT-Live-1.1 system card reports mixed voice-safety evaluation results. On its voice-native production-prompt set, the company reports no statistically significant regressions versus GPT-Live-1. On its deliberately difficult synthetic-prompt set, it reports statistically significant regressions for GPT-Live-1.1 in sexual, mental-health, emotional-reliance and gore categories; it also reports slight regression on a restrictions-respect evaluation and mixed changes on blocker-disclosure and broken-search tasks. These are first-party results, and neither prompt set estimates safety-event prevalence in production traffic.
